name: app.trickl/trickl
title: Trickl
description: Trickl for AI assistants: full docs, setup plans, and sandbox tools to test purchases end to end.

tools.name: get_started
tools.description: Start here. Without an integration, explains the ways to add Trickl (own business such as a SaaS, or a multi-seller platform) and how to choose. With one, returns a step-by-step plan for the coding agent: keys, exact API calls, webhook handling, what to store, and how to prove it works with this server's sandbox tools.

integration.description: own_*: the user's own business gets paid (SaaS, app, course, membership); own_embedded_checkout puts checkout inside their app. platform_*: many sellers on the user's platform get paid. embedded = in-page iframe, hosted = redirect to Trickl. embed_widget: paste-in pricing widget, no backend. Omit to see the choices.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Keyword search over the Trickl partner docs (platform API, webhooks, embed widget). Returns section ids with snippets; read one with read_doc. Leave query empty for the full table of contents.

tools.name: read_doc
tools.description: Returns one section of the Trickl docs in full (Markdown), by id from search_docs.

tools.name: check_api_key
tools.description: Confirms this connector's test key works and shows its platform, scopes and mode. Run it before the other sandbox tools; if it fails, the message says what the user needs to fix.

tools.name: register_test_provider
tools.description: Registers a seller (provider) under the test key via POST /providers/register and returns providerLinkCode (needed to create goals) and webhookSecret (to verify webhooks). Idempotent on externalCreatorId. webhookUrl must be a public https URL that reaches the user's receiver, e.g. an ngrok or cloudflared tunnel to localhost. Sandbox webhooks are real signed HTTP requests.

webhookUrl.description: https URL of the user's webhook receiver

externalCreatorId.description: The seller's id in the user's app. Default: sandbox-seller-1

email.description: Must not belong to an existing Trickl provider. Default: a per-seller @example.com address

websiteUrl.description: Seller site; its host is allowed for redirects and embedded checkout

stripeConnectAccountId.description: Leave empty in sandbox: a placeholder is used, since sandbox goals never reach Stripe

tools.name: create_test_goal
tools.description: Creates a goal with POST /goals/create using the test key. No money moves. Returns goalId, paymentUrl (hosted checkout) and clientSecret (embedded checkout). Amounts are integer cents, USD.

description.description: What the buyer is saving for, max 500 characters

metadata.description: Echoed verbatim in every webhook, e.g. { orderId }

depositAmount.description: Upfront card charge in cents. One-time: ≥ 50 and < targetAmount. Subscription: = targetAmount or omit

frequency.description: Makes it a recurring subscription; omit for a one-time purchase

deadline.description: ISO 8601 due date, 24h to 2 years out (one-time goals only)

callbackUrl.description: Where the buyer returns after confirming; localhost is allowed in test mode

tools.name: get_goal
tools.description: Returns a sandbox goal's current state via GET /goals/:goalId: status, amounts saved, buyer, deadline.

tools.name: simulate_goal_event
tools.description: Moves a sandbox goal through its lifecycle instantly; each event sends the real signed webhook to the seller's webhookUrl, exactly as live would. confirm: the buyer signs up and links a bank (goal.deposit_paid if there is a deposit; for subscriptions also goal.subscription_created, plus goal.cycle_paid at once if the deposit paid the first period in full). collect: one collected chunk (round-ups and/or Trickl Down, which arrive the same way), $3 by default (goal.round_up_collected); fails with ALREADY_FUNDED when the current period is already paid. complete: one-time goals finish (goal.completed); subscriptions pay the current period and start the next (goal.cycle_paid; the goal stays SAVING). payment_failed: a failed chunk (goal.payment_failed), with reversal=true for the clawback path. expire: a deadline goal fell short (goal.deadline_charge_failed). Confirm first.

reversal.description: payment_failed only: true = a chunk already counted is reversed (clawback); false = a collection failed

tools.name: cancel_test_goal
tools.description: Cancels a sandbox goal via POST /goals/:goalId/cancel, as the user's server would when a customer cancels: collected chunks (and a refundable deposit) are refunded less Trickl's fee, in the ledger only, and goal.cancelled is sent.

tools.name: list_webhook_deliveries
tools.description: Shows every webhook Trickl sent for a sandbox goal, newest first, with its payload and the receiver's result. DELIVERED = got a 2xx. FAILED = rejected, retry scheduled at nextRetryAt. EXHAUSTED = gave up. PENDING / DELIVERING = in flight; check again in a few seconds. Use lastStatusCode and lastError to debug the receiver.
